nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
GEIRU WINDOW DIRECTOR - CLOWN BIKER BABE (8 windows, 60 seconds)

Geiru, the clown, says her line and pulls on her helmet (window 1), races at a ramp (2), flies off it in a slow-motion superman (3), rides standing on the pegs and pops a wheelie (4), jumps a row of parked cars (5), rides the loop (6), goes off a cliff and skids (7), then stops, unzips a little and pulls her helmet off in slow motion (8).

HOW TO USE
1. Load your character picture in "Picture 1 (subject)".
2. Write each window's prompt in its H3 Prompt IDE node (Window 1-8). They feed the eight PROMPT nodes.
3. On Geiru Window Director, press Run/Re-roll to make window 1. Use the node's buttons, not ComfyUI's Run button.
4. Look at it. Approve keeps it and makes the next window. Run/Re-roll makes it again (change its prompt or the seed first, or turn on new_seed_on_reroll).
5. Changed your mind about an earlier window? Click it in the strip, then Rewind to selected.
6. When all 8 windows are made, press Blend all: it runs the blended last steps over the whole video, which smooths the joins. Want the windows joined exactly as you approved them instead? Turn on bypass_blend and the button becomes Join all.

SETTINGS THAT MATTER
- One prompt per window: 8 prompts, PROMPT 1 length about 60 s, Hybrid Windows context_length 226 / overlap 39 = 8 windows. With split_conds_to_windows on, the prompts are spread evenly over the video, so the number of prompts should match the number of windows.
- finished_handoff is ON in Geiru Hybrid Windows: each window builds on the finished window you approved. Keep it on with the Director.
- run_name keeps each take in output/geiru_window_director/<run_name>. A new name = a new take. Reset clears a take.
- Nothing resets on its own: if you change the length, size, steps or window settings, the run stops with a message. Set them back, or press Reset.
- The sound is made by H3 from the prompts (no audio is loaded).

nodes.title: DOWNLOAD LINKS - where to get every node
widgets_values:
WHERE TO GET THE NODES IN THIS WORKFLOW

Geiru Hybrid Windows + Geiru Window Director (Geiru Context Suite):
https://github.com/roycho87/geiru_context_suite
Needs ComfyUI updated to a version with MiniMax H3 context windows (PR #17425).

H3 Prompt IDE (the eight window prompt nodes):
https://github.com/ethanfel/ComfyUI-H3-Prompt-IDE

Save Latent (the SAVE LATENT node) - install ONE of these, not both (they use the same node names). Optional: delete the node if you don't want the latent saved.
  H3 Motion Context: https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
  H3 Motion Context MultiRef: https://github.com/seitanism/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef

KJNodes (the VRAM saver and Sage attention nodes, optional - bypass them if you don't have them):
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

VideoHelperSuite (Video Combine):
https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

Everything else is built into ComfyUI. Update ComfyUI if the MiniMax H3 nodes are missing.
